faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.description: Can't find the answer you're looking for? Reach out to our customer support team.

items.q1: What is {appName} and how does it work?
items.a1: {appName} is a production-ready starter template for building SaaS products. It comes with authentication, internationalization, theming, and modern development tooling out of the box.
items.q2: Is there a free plan available?
items.a2: Yes! We offer a generous free tier that includes 25 credits per month, 2GB of storage, and up to 200 projects. You can upgrade anytime as your needs grow.
items.q3: How do I customize the theme?
items.a3: You can customize the theme through the settings panel or by modifying the theme configuration file. We support light mode, dark mode, and system preference detection.
items.a4: Currently we support English and Simplified Chinese. More languages can be easily added through the internationalization system built on next-intl.
items.q5: Can I use this for commercial projects?
items.a5: Absolutely. The template is designed for commercial use. You can build and deploy production applications with no restrictions.
items.a6: You can reach our support team through the help center in the app, or visit our GitHub repository to file issues and participate in discussions.
